scope: three-engine native in-process feed, zero history; isolated semantic metadata performance qualification; no GUI or universal parity claim
interpretation: Feature-cost observation, not whole-app parity or a claimed optimization. All40 common state gates passed. Six workload windows recorded one10ms kernel tick each on CPU24; preserve flags rather than treating the host as perfectly idle. Unrelated compilers elsewhere were observed and permitted. Snapshot sampling cannot exclude unsampled migration.
load_policy: Serialize own heavy jobs; preflight chosen core and SMT sibling below10percent. Record unrelated processes and all-core activity; do not require the whole host idle. Flag per-case SMT sibling activity above10percent and external CPU-tick progress observed on a selected core. Snapshots can miss migrations; raw mpstat retained.
